Find Your Section

Tell us your child's age and we'll show the sections and meeting times that fit. You don't need to know how Scouts is organised, we'll do that bit.

  1. 1About your child
  2. 2When
  3. 3Whereabouts

About your child

Enter their date of birth, or their age in years, whichever is easier.

or

When works best?

Pick any days that suit, or leave it as Any day. This is optional.

Whereabouts?

Choose a general area if you have a preference, or leave it as Any area. We only show broad areas, never exact venues. This is optional.

🔒We use your child's date of birth or age only to show the right section on this page right now. It isn't saved, shared, or added to any analytics.

💬Prefer to talk it through? Contact us and we'll help you find the right section and meeting.

7th Swindon Scout Group

Part of Swindon North Scout District, we're one of the largest Scout Groups in North Swindon, helping over 300 young people develop skills for life every week.

Charity Number: 306101
